description: This Java class, LogWrapper, wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate custom logging and chaining log handlers within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class for wrapping Android's native logging utility, enabling chained logging functionality.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Handles the actual logging to Android's log system and propagates the log to the next node if available.
